author: ojiudezue
title: v5.103.82 shipped: Daily solar uses the production CT counter
summary: Daily solar uses the production CT counter
why: Operator asked to confirm it was not a cumulative non-issue: the counter's flaps land on day boundaries, so day deltas were 0.0 on 5 and NULL on 31 of 40 days, and consumption (forecast training) was understated. The CT counter is monotonic, same unit, agrees when healthy. Chose re-seed-to-NULL on the switch day over a cross-entity delta, and NULL with no learning over the net-import-only legacy fallback (review A MEDIUM), because a missing day is safer for the forecast than a wrong one.
implications: Shipped EC-SOLAR-LIFETIME-COUNTER-FLAP-1 at v5.103.82; card(s) sit shipped_organic pending validation. Acceptance in README_v5.103.82.md (Live criteria).
revisit_trigger: First midnight after the switch day: energy_daily solar_production_kwh matches the CT daily delta within 1%

refs.release_notes:
- EC daily solar/consumption now read the Envoy production CT counter; the lifetime production counter flaps to 0.046 MWh and left energy_daily solar 0.0 or NULL on most days
- A day whose production baseline is rejected (entity switch or flap) records NULL solar and consumption and trains nothing
